issues.description: Constructor mismatch for class de.tum.cit.ase.Lecture: the template repository defines a constructor with three parameters (public Lecture(String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents)) while the problem statement (UML and task description) and the reference solution define/expect a constructor that initializes five attributes and therefore takes five parameters in this order: (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). This discrepancy will confuse students about the required constructor signature and the order/number of attributes to initialize and can cause automated checks that expect the five-argument constructor to fail.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the template with the problem specification: replace the current three-parameter constructor stub with a five-parameter constructor signature and implementation that initializes all attributes in the UML order (String lectureName, int numberOfInscribedStudents, int numberOfGuestStudents, int numberOfLecturers, int numberOfTutors). Alternatively, remove the incorrect three-arg stub and leave a TODO with the correct five-argument constructor signature so students implement it exactly as specified.
